entities.name: Ixalan (continent)
entities.description: A great crescent-shaped western continent of deep jungles, rivers and colossal dinosaurs that gives its name to the plane; cradle of the Sun Empire, River Heralds, Legion of Dusk and Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Ixalan's empire, once steward of the Immortal Sun, pushed toward the coasts after abusing it, and now rebuilt with Orazca as capital.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Elusive merfolk who guard the waterways and hidden shrines and reclaimed much of the interior jungle.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampiric empire from Torrezon that crossed the seas seeking the Immortal Sun and the city of gold.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Freewheeling pirate nation that carved out havens like Sunray Bay.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact the Sun Empire stewarded until its abuse fractured the balance with the River Heralds.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city now restored as the Sun Empire's capital.

entities.name: Azcanta
entities.description: Once a thriving Sun Empire city swallowed by the ocean during a war with the River Heralds.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: Fungal being whose spreading fungus devours settlements like Downtown and Sunray Bay.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Ancient bat god whose cult lingers in the Temple of Aclazotz's underworld.

entities.name: Sunray Bay
entities.description: Pirate town corrupted by the Mycotyrant's fungus.

entities.name: Miraldanor
entities.description: An island stronghold of the Legion of Dusk named after Queen Miralda.

entities.name: Adanto
entities.description: The first and oldest Legion of Dusk fort on Ixalan, frequently besieged by Coalition pirates.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: Former capital of the Sun Empire, ruined in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Atzocan
entities.description: A coastal Sun Empire city-state destroyed by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: Vast city of temples destroyed by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Deeproot Tree
entities.description: Remnant of an ancient merfolk city, destroyed in the New Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Ixalan suffered deeply.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: Oversees the Conqueror's Foothold prison as a base for her ruthless ambitions.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Continent from which the Legion of Dusk came and which the Sun Empire plans to invade.

events.summary: The Sun Empire abuses the Immortal Sun's power, fracturing its balance with the River Heralds and pushing the empire toward the coasts.
events.quote: until its abuse of the artifact’s power fractured that balance

events.summary: A prolonged war with the River Heralds causes Azcanta to sink beneath the ocean.
events.quote: swallowed by the ocean during a war with the River Heralds

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk crosses the seas seeking the Immortal Sun and the city of gold, building forts and clashing with the Sun Empire, River Heralds and pirates.
events.quote: crossed the seas in search of the Immortal Sun and the fabled city of gold

events.summary: The Sun Empire takes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk to the sea; Fort Leor falls.
events.quote: After the Sun Empire took Orazca and pushed the Legion of Dusk to the sea

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Otepec and Atzocan fall and the Deeproot Tree withers.
events.quote: Cities like Otepec and Atzocan fell

events.summary: After the invasion the Sun Empire moves its capital back to Orazca and begins a campaign to invade Torrezon using reverse-engineered ships.
events.quote: the Sun Empire moved its capital back to Orazca

events.summary: The Mycotyrant's fungus devours Downtown and Sunray Bay.
events.quote: the Mycotyrant 's fungus spreads silently, devouring entire settlements like Downtown and Sunray Bay

relations.note: Once in harmony, then in conflict.
relations.quote: Conflicts with the River Heralds and rogue kings like those of Quetzatl shaped the borders

relations.note: Clashed and pushed them to the sea.
relations.quote: they clashed with the Sun Empire and the River Heralds

relations.note: Pirates frequently besiege the Legion's fort.
relations.quote: frequently besieged by the pirates of the Brazen Coalition
Ixalan is the cradle of the Sun Empire

relations.note: Oversees the Conqueror's Foothold outpost of the Legion.
relations.quote: The fortress is overseen by Vona de Iedo
